build: Native GitHub Pages Jekyll, root and /preview
external_method: Every original unique HTTP(S) destination was checked with HEAD and GET fallback. Four verified replacement destinations were then checked with the same method. Fragments are checked locally, not on third-party sites. Authentication, bot restrictions, proxy failures and rate limits remain unverified; HTTP success does not verify third-party editorial accuracy.
manufacturer_regressions: Missing, empty and unresolved references cannot enumerate organisations or render blank fact links; invalid related types cannot reuse a previous collection.
